task.question: Who was appointed as the president and chief executive officer of the Rochester Philharmonic Orchestra effective August 17, 2026?
task.evidence: The Rochester Philharmonic Orchestra announces the appointment of Tonya McBride Robles as its next president and chief executive officer, effective 17 August 2026.
